name: awrad-contracts
description: Tooling for the shared Awrad contracts: OpenAPI lint/bundle and fixture-format checks.

scripts.bundle: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle api/openapi.yaml -o api/openapi.bundled.json
scripts.test: npm run check:bundle && npm run lint:api && npm run check:rules && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:catalogs && npm run check:dhikr-catalog && npm run check:sync && npm run check:audio && npm run check:fixture-format
